RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (four-swap, staged, below the floor; not owner-presentable by itself). The preferred five without Possession Engine, keeping the owner-retained Blasphemous Act. Choose if the owner wants a fourth board reset; Act also kills Eggman and our artifact creatures.

Choose if the owner values the cast-cost reduction over Munitions tokens on every nontoken artifact entering. LOW-MODERATE confidence; close call.

REJECT (five-swap, staged). Shuttle adds a second villainous choice on attack (doubled by The Valeyard), but the opponent may sacrifice their worst creature: the permissive-choice critique the owner applied to Damocles Base on 2026-10-14. MODERATE confidence.

REJECT (six-swap, staged; Pass C requested test). Bounded 192-cell grid (mechanics test): Caress live in 72 cells (drains 12 per trigger at hand 3/Valeyard/discard, 6 without Valeyard); Welder live in 64 (needs an artifact card in our graveyard and an artifact to trade) and puts onto the battlefield, never into hand, so it doesn't feed Eggman's put branch. Pass C KEEP stands. MODERATE confidence.
